name: cc-imessage-control
description: Text yourself 'Claude <projectname>' OR 'skill <command>' and your Mac (iMessage) or Linux box opens a new local Claude Code session with /remote-control on. 'Claude' mode opens the project; 'skill' mode runs a plugin's slash command in its project dir. Drive both from the Claude mobile app. No chat.db reading.

plugins.name: cc-imessage-control
plugins.description: Spin up Claude Code Remote Control sessions on your Mac (via iMessage Shortcuts) or Linux box (via SSH over Tailscale; HTTP listener fallback). Two keywords: 'Claude <project>' opens a project; 'skill <phrase>' fires a plugin slash command. Ships router scripts, an interactive setup wizard, and a ready-made iPhone SSH shortcut.
